entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I... I need to make a return. I bought a helmet and it's just not right. I'm so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can I get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number VF-78-22-91. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I just... I really hoped this would work out.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. I can definitely see you've been with us for a while, and we appreciate that. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's the color. It looked different online, and it just clashes with all my gear. I know it sounds silly, but I haven't even taken it out of its packaging. The box unopened, still sitting there, reminding me. I feel so bad about it, I really needed that money for bills this month.
I understand completely. Getting the right gear that you feel good in is important. Let me just check the policy for you. I see the delivery was 19 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? Time just got away from me. I really hope that's not a problem.
Not at all, Sarah. I'm looking at our policy right now, and for standard items like this helmet, you have a full 90 days to make a return. You are well within that window.
Really? Oh, that is such a relief! You have no idea.

Of course. Your safety is our top priority, and we want to make sure you have a helmet you'll actually wear and feel confident in. Since it's just a color preference, I can process this return for a full refund for you right away. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just package it up and drop it at any post office.
Thank you so much, Isaac! That's wonderful news. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
